description: Base prompts for jailbreak testing — abstract/generic to avoid real harm. Each prompt asks *about* a sensitive topic at an informational, policy, or defensive-research level; the adversarial framing is applied separately by the attack strategies in strategies/, not by these base prompts. `category` drives risk-scoring weights (core/scorer.py); `tags` may include `multilingual` for non-English entries, whose `language` field (ISO 639-1) supports language-based reporting.
category_taxonomy_note: Content-risk categories here (general/deception/privacy/illegal/violence/weapons/malware) are orthogonal to attack-technique categories. 'Prompt Injection' and 'Roleplay' correspond to the `strategy` field (instruction_override, roleplay); 'System Leakage' corresponds to the `system_prompt_leak` evaluator outcome; 'Jailbreak' is the umbrella name for the exercise as a whole; 'Multilingual' corresponds to `language` != 'en' / the `multilingual` tag.
